CENTRAL EUROPEAN JEWS
5422 O
110
March 1, 1940.

The immigration into the International Settlement
of Shanghai of Jewish refugees from Europe is now under
the control of the Municipal Police and without Immigration
Certificates issued by the Police entry is not allowed.
（批：No. 5/28/44 A.I.）

Those refugees who have been residing in Shanghai
for some length of time - twelve months or so - and who
have established themselves as honest, self-supporting
citizens are allowed to apply for permission to bring their
relatives into the Settlement. The applicants must be
financially competent and of good character and if their
incomes are sufficient to support the prospective new
arrivals without their becoming a public charge then their
applications are given consideration. In addition certain
reputable concerns of good standing offer employment to
Jews now residing in Europe and thus afford these persons
the opportunity of settling down in Shanghai. The salaries
offered in such instances must be sufficient to permit the
new comers to be self-supporting.

In both instances, as outlined above, the applications
are submitted to the Special Branch of the Municipal Police
through the intermediary of the Committee For the Assistance
of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai, 177 Embankment
Building. The Committee receives the applications and,
if approving of them, passes them to [涂黑], Chairman
of the Committee, for signature, indicating that the
applicants are able to carry out the obligations they
undertake in their applications.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 31 MAR. 1940）

The applications are then returned to the applicants
who then appear at Police Headquarters on Tuesday and
Friday mornings with their applications.

The Special Branch take possession of the applications
and make each and every one the subject of an intensive
investigation. Proof of possessing sufficient financial
means is the main point in respect of applicants requiring

中欧犹太人
5422 O
110
1940年3月1日。

目前，欧洲犹太难民进入上海公共租界的移民事宜由工部局警务处管控，若无警务处签发的入境许可证，则不准入境。
（批注：No. 5/28/44 A.I.）

那些已在上海居住相当一段时间——约十二个月左右——并已确立为诚实、自食其力的公民的难民，获准申请许可将其亲属带入租界。申请人必须具备经济能力且品行良好，如果其收入足以供养拟新抵达的人员，而不致使其成为公共负担，则其申请将予以考虑。此外，某些信誉良好的商号为目前居住在欧洲的犹太人提供就业机会，从而为这些人提供了在上海定居的机会。在此类情况下提供的薪水必须足以使新来者能够自食其力。

在上述两种情形中，申请均通过“上海援助欧洲犹太难民委员会”（地址：外滩大楼177号）作为中介，提交至工部局警务处政治部。该委员会接收申请，如予批准，则转交[涂黑]（委员会主席）签署，表明申请人有能力履行其在申请中承诺的义务。
（印章：上海工部局总办处 1940年3月31日）

随后，申请表格退回给申请人，申请人须于周二和周五上午携带申请表前往警察总局。

政治部接收申请表，并对每一份申请进行详尽调查。对于要求亲属移民的申请人而言，证明拥有足够财力是主要考量点；而在提供就业的情形中，负责调查的警官会仔细核实所提出的合同是合法有效的，而非仅是一纸空文。然而，政治部以各种理由驳回了大部分申请，尽管有人观察到多次试图规避所施加限制的行为，但申请人从未成功。
向成功的申请人签发有效期为四个月的许可证，并收取名义费用。随后，由申请人将这些证书寄送给欧洲的难民。
数周或数月后，相关难民抵达上海。其下船后须向政治部报到，届时记录其个人详细资料，并收回并注销许可证。
他（她）被要求居住在苏州河以南的租界区域内，政治部保持充分的核查，以确保此项命令得到执行。
政治部与犹太各委员会之间始终保持密切联系，以便即时获取所有与犹太移民问题相关的信息。

K 39/1
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. ____
Date ____）

February 24, 40.

Paul Komor, Esq.,
Hon. Secretary,
The International Committee for the
Organization of European Immigrants in China,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have to refer to your letter of February 19
regarding a transit visa for Mr. and Mrs. Ettinger.

It is felt that it is not appropriate for the
Council to assume responsibilities in respect of refugees
coming to China who wish to reside in cities other than
Shanghai.

Whilst in the case of Mr. and Mrs. Ettinger the
Police are prepared to issue a permit for their entry into
and temporary residence in the International Settlement
south of Soochow Creek, such permit cannot be issued until
such time as the Police have evidence that there is no
objection on the part of the local Japanese Consular
authorities. It would be necessary, therefore, for your
Committee first to approach the latter authorities.

I return the four enclosures accompanying your
letter.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

E. T. NASH
Assistant Secretary.

（批：DATE 26/ 2/ 40
fn/
encl.）

政治部登记处
编号 S. B. D. ____
日期 ____）

1940年2月24日。

Paul Komor 先生，
荣誉秘书，
在华欧洲移民组织国际委员会，
上海。

先生：

谨复阁下2月19日来信，关于 Ettinger 夫妇过境签证一事。

当局认为，工部局不宜对希望居住在上海以外其他城市的来华难民承担责任。

虽然在 Ettinger 夫妇一案中，警务处准备签发许可证，允许其进入并暂时居住在苏州河以南的公共租界内，但在警务处获得证据表明日本当地领事当局对此不持异议之前，不能签发此类许可证。因此，贵委员会有必要首先接洽后者当局。

现退回随函附上的四份附件。

此致，

您顺从的仆人，

E. T. NASH
助理秘书。

（批注：日期 1940年2月26日
fn/
附件。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
S. B. DISTRY
No. S. B. D. 5422 A
Date 23 2 40

February 23 40.

E. T. Nash, Esq.,
Assistant Secretary,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Dear Nash,

With reference to the application
for a transit visa for Mr. and Mrs. O. Ettinger
made by the Jewish Committee, I am of the opinion
that the views of H.I.J.M. Consular Authorities
ought to be obtained.

Obviously Mr. and Mrs. Ettinger are
not in the least likely to become indigent cases,
but it would be a mistake, I think, for us to
undertake obligations in respect of persons
coming to China to reside in cities other than
Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,

〔签名〕

Assistant Commissioner
(Special Branch)

Original enclosure
returned. 23/2/40

上海工部局
政治部
编号 S. B. D. 5422 A
日期 1940年2月23日

1940年2月23日。

E. T. Nash 先生，
助理秘书，
上海工部局。

亲爱的 Nash：

关于犹太委员会为 O. Ettinger 夫妇申请的过境签证，我认为应当征询日本帝国陛下领事当局的意见。

显然，Ettinger 夫妇极不可能成为贫困难民，但我认为，如果我们承担有关来华居住在上海以外城市人员的义务，将是一个错误。

此致，

〔签名〕

助理处长
（政治部）

原件附件
已退回。1940年2月23日
